root_cause_label: Tool Misuse: Text Reader Invoked On Binary Parquet, Triggering Runtime Crash
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent invoked the text-based [read] tool (cat -n) on a binary Parquet file, triggering a runtime crash that halted all progress at step 4 before any code was written.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: agent executed '[read] /data/source_c/users.parquet', applying the same text-based cat-n reader used for JSON and CSV to a binary Parquet file; this triggered the runtime crash.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4: the runtime crash message 'The action has not been executed due to a runtime error. The runtime system may have crashed and restarted' ends the trajectory with no further steps possible.
t_surface_evidence: Step 4 terminal output: 'The action has not been executed due to a runtime error. The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints.'
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked the knowledge that Parquet is a binary columnar format incompatible with text-based reading tools (cat -n). It applied the same exploration strategy uniformly across JSON, CSV, and Parquet without recognizing that the latter requires a programmatic reader (e.g., pandas/pyarrow). The correct approach from the outset would have been to write a Python script to load all three sources.
